title: Dangerous Goods Acceptance: One Administration Fee per Approval Date
content:
## Clause

A Dangerous Goods Acceptance file bears no more than one administration fee for any one approval date, since a charge code is booked a single time per charging date. The desk looks at the acceptance's account for an administration-fee entry already dated on the handling date. If there is one, the administration fee now is 0.00; if there is none, this rule places no restriction on it.

## Cases

| Administration-fee entries on the account | Dated on the handling date? | Effect on the fee now |
|---|---|---|
| none | — | no restriction from this rule |
| one, dated three weeks earlier | no | no restriction from this rule |
| one, dated today | yes | 0.00 |

## Point of judgement

**An acceptance was approved, reopened and is approved again on the same day.** The second approval that day carries no further administration fee.
